verdict.rationale: Kling's own marketing says users can batch-produce videos and "automate the entire production process" (kling-docs-7), and it describes an in-product Agent and Skills that generate assets in parallel (kling-docs-3, kling-docs-4). However, none of this shows user-configured automations that run unattended in the background; the Agent is presented as an interactive brainstorming and editing loop. The REST API and MCP/CLI access are developer building blocks for external agents, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: documented background or scheduled automation setup, triggers or recurring runs, unattended execution with notifications or results, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
